answers:
Try this:
SELECT
  zakats.tglawalhaul,
  zakats.tglakhirhaul,
  zakats.user_id,
  SUM(bayarlanjas.bayarlanja) AS total_bayar
FROM
  zakats
LEFT JOIN bayarlanjas ON bayarlanjas.user_id = zakats.user_id
  AND bayarlanjas.tglbayar BETWEEN zakats.tglawalhaul AND zakats.tglakhirhaul
WHERE
  zakats.user_id = 1
GROUP BY
  zakats.tglawalhaul,
  zakats.tglakhirhaul,
  zakats.user_id
